ticker_news.title: AI PCs are garnering interest; Apple the greatest share gainer By Investing.com - Investing.com Australia
ticker_news.description: The PC market is seeing growth driven by commercial refreshes and the emergence of AI PCs, with Apple gaining the most market share among top vendors.
ticker_news.author: Sam Bougheddad

ticker_news.title: AMD to Acquire Silo AI to Expand Enterprise AI Solutions Globally - GlobeNewswire
ticker_news.description: AMD announced the acquisition of Silo AI, Europe's largest private AI lab, for $665 million. The acquisition will accelerate the development and deployment of AMD-powered AI models and software solutions, enhancing open-source AI capabilities for efficient training and inference on AMD platforms.
ticker_news.author: Amd
